assessment: Since its initial inception, as a sample thinning technique for cryo-electron tomography, cryo-focused ion beam (FIB) milling has developed to include a range of different methodologies. At the moment, there is no dedicated software that is able to integrate all these methodologies and their supporting software packages. Klumpe et al. aimed to alleviate this problem by developing an open-source software tool, SerialFIB. SerialFIB allows users to set up automated protocols for on-grid lamella preparation, FIB-SEM volume imaging, and lift-out trench milling. This work has significant importance for the field as it decouples the need for proprietary software for the execution of highly specialized milling protocols.
